description: This header file defines inline functions for mapping MIME types to GStreamer capabilities (GstCaps) and vice versa, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes functions to create GstCaps from MIME types and to convert a list of GstCaps to a set of MIME types, utilizing external classes like IGstWrapper and IMediaPipeline::MediaSource.

methods.name: createSimpleCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates a GstCaps object representing simple capabilities for a given MIME type, based on a mapping from MIME to media type strings.

methods.name: convertFromCapsVectorToMimeSet
methods.description: Converts a vector of GstCaps pointers into a set of MIME type strings by checking for intersections with predefined capabilities.
